title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VI: the cards it left out
notes: The rest of the designer's sixth Stinkyscape+ balance pass (#4440), the eleven cards the first part (#4465) left out; its last item, the Smoothies' rework, is a part of its own. Devil's Pact is Tradable on both faces (R1838000); Bogos Binted (2); Bread and Butter's X adds a declared bonus, 1 (Radiant 3), to the Float's product once a Float springs it, a definition with none adding 0 (R2657006); Thorium Reactor's chance 12%; Noxious Rounds 3/1 (Radiant 6/1), the stat standard's second named exception (R4440005); Suppressive Aura (1), Embiggened (3); Tetrative Reconstructor Tribute 3; Cloaked Toe Cracker 3/6 (Radiant 6/12), its base Aura (2) less and its Radiant face's mana gone; Professor Curvature 4/5 (Radiant 8/10); Wardrum without Divine Shield. Tetrative Reconstructor's and Cloaked Toe Cracker's scripts keep their v0.6.11b ones (R767000). Ruling R4440005.

player.title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VI, the rest
balance: Bread and Butter's Bread Token is X/X with X = the Float + 1 (Radiant 3 × the Float + 3), up from the Float (Radiant 3 × the Float).
Bread and Butter still makes nothing when a turn ends with no mana left.
Thorium Reactor blows up 12% of the time, down from 15%.
Suppressive Aura costs (1), Embiggened (3), down from (2), Embiggened (4).
Tetrative Reconstructor has Tribute 3, down from Tribute 4.
Cloaked Toe Cracker is 3/6 (Radiant 6/12), up from 3/4 (Radiant 6/8).
Cloaked Toe Cracker's Aura makes your Traps cost (2) less (Radiant: (0)), and its Radiant face no longer gains mana after you play a Trap.
Wardrum no longer has Divine Shield.
